notes: Latest means the selected supported release channel checked on the recorded date. It is not an automatic update guarantee.
EKS 1.37 is confirmed in us-west-2 by describe-cluster-versions and AWS’s October 2026 release announcement. kubectl 1.37.1 matches it. AWS add-ons select the latest compatible build at plan time.
Terraform 1.17 prereleases and Lambda Python 3.15 preview are excluded. NGINX follows its stable channel, not mainline.
The stable Alpine 3.24.2 helper replaces the standalone BusyBox image. BusyBox labels 1.38.0 unstable; its latest explicitly stable standalone release is 1.36.1 from 2023.

Local validation does not mean deployed to AWS. A bounded Game 05 Lambda/DynamoDB fault, Terraform repair and cleanup were observed in us-west-2. A separate EKS 1.37 foundation and scenario-01 image-pull repair also passed live checks. See docs/VALIDATION.md for the exact scope, deletion evidence and untested lessons.
Alpine utility smoke checks ran extracted image binaries as host processes, not inside a container or Kubernetes cluster.
Host Python 3.12.3 ran the three Lambda handler unit tests. The local web runtime remains Python >=3.10 and requires no Node runtime.
